behaviors.behavior: a valid header-indexed `Depends On` column round-trips through `parse_campaign_skeleton` into `[id, ...]` lists, comma-separated and markdown-emphasis-stripped per token, with an empty cell reading as `[]`
a campaign.md with no `Depends On` column falls back to the legacy fixed id/slug/title positions and every row defaults to `depends_on: []`
a UTF-8 BOM prefixing a frontmatter-less campaign.md no longer breaks `## Sub-Iterates` header detection (real bug found via empirical boundary probing, fixed with `lstrip("\ufeff")`)

`validate_dependency_graph` rejects duplicate ids, unknown references, self-dependency, and cycles of any length as structural findings, case-folding BOTH duplicate-detection and existence-resolution so `R0`/`r0` collide and `depends_on: [r0]` resolves against `R0`
a row with a missing or non-string id is reported as its own structural finding rather than raising `TypeError` in a bare set/sort
`check_frozen_contracts` reverts a `depends_on` edit on any non-pending unit to its frozen `loop_state.json` value, case-insensitively matched, and names the unit in a `warnings` entry

`campaign_init.py` hard-rejects a structural violation or a charset violation at write time, and rejects a non-list / non-string-membership `depends_on` value with a clean `ValueError` naming the offending id (not an uncaught `TypeError`)

`lib.loop_state.is_unit_ready` requires every declared dependency to be `merged` with a `merged_commit` freshly verified (fetch + `git merge-base --is-ancestor`) against `origin/<default>` -- a failed fetch, a non-hex-SHA value, or an unverified commit all degrade SAFELY to blocked, never falsely unblocking

the resume-safe loader maps `status.json`'s terminal statuses onto unit statuses (`complete`/`done` -> `merged`, `failed`/`escalated` -> `failed`) and prefers a durable `merged_commit` over the legacy `commit` field once one is present

END-TO-END: `cmd_next`'s `kind == "sub_iterate"`-gated readiness guard skips a pending-but-blocked unit in favor of the next FIFO-eligible candidate, still claims an independent sibling despite a blocked unit ahead of it in FIFO order, claims the dependent once its dependency is `merged` and ancestry-verified, and falls through to `{"done": true}` with observable `blocked_pending_ids`/`blockers` fields when every remaining unit is blocked -- `kind == "section"` (shipwright-build) is completely unaffected
